payload.comment: All four artefacts (ingestion, preprocessing, profiling, data_profile) are internally consistent. Split sizes (89996/10004/7180 = 107180) match official PathMNIST; class-count arrays sum to split totals; imbalance ratio 1.633908 = 12885/7886 verified; n_classes=9, 28×28×3, schema 1.0, seed 42 uniform across artefacts. No deterministic findings outstanding. The sole recurring minor issue — test-set max/min cited as ≈3.64 in ambiguity_risks prose vs. 1338/339 ≈ 3.95 from structured class_counts — is a cosmetic narrative rounding slip already flagged in two prior reviews; structured data is correct and no pipeline logic depends on the prose value. The future-dated created_at (2026-09-08) is a system-clock arteffect with no reproducibility impact. The data_profile adequately documents cross-CR
